note: The facts of the terms rows of Claude and of its SDK transport (F125-FR-005, F125-FR-037). Every row rests on documentation only: unverified, access date 2026-09-29 (R8v), re-read every 30 days (ruling 59). Feature 147 owns the terms gate; this adapter supplies the facts. The quoted sentences, sources and access dates live here, from research/R8v-terms-verification.md rows 1 to 6. The audience `distributed` defaults to auth tier 2.

rows.basis: An end user signing in to the unmodified Claude Code binary with their own subscription; a one-year token from `claude setup-token` for scripts
rows.source: research/R8v-terms-verification.md row 1 (consumer terms of claude.ai, use of the Claude Code binary)

rows.basis: Third parties may not offer claude.ai login or its rate limits in their products unless approved; the carve-out is confirmed for personal use only. Opt-in, marked "personal use only", with a warning
rows.source: research/R8v-terms-verification.md row 2 (commercial terms, third-party offering clause)

The SDK never carries a subscription login (ruling 70)
